newsitem.title: UK: UK stocks end higher as Dow firms, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK stocks end higher as Dow firms, trade quiet.

text.p: UK shares ended modestly higher on Monday, underpinned by a firmer Wall Street, but trading volumes were thin as investors remained wary about a possible near-term Dow sell-off, dealers said.
"At the end of the day we still have quite a bit of uncertainty. People are reluctant to buy at what could be the top of the market," one dealer said.
The FTSE 100 index of leading stocks ended 21.4 points higher at 3,993.8.
"To say it has been dull is an understatement. It has been like watching paint dry today, except without the excitement," the head of trading at a large stockbrokers said.
